title: Owen Muir Joins The Mental Health Forecast Show
subtitle: My colleague watches a new podcast, and I'm thrilled to be a guest.
body_html:
Hey readers of The Frontier Psychiatrists, a newsletter edited by Owen Scott Muir, M.D., DFAACAP, he was just on a podcast made by a friend and colleague, Arjun Nanda, M.D.

Check out Owen on the mental health forecast!

Thanks for listening, and we will be back with more writing tomorrow.

Share
